name: Reader
subtitle: Read books and documents offline
description:
Read EPUB, DRM-free AZW3 and MOBI, PDFs, comics and documents from the Kindle Documents folder. Browse chapters, follow links, adjust type and margins, and keep bookmarks, highlights and notes. Read extracted EPUB folders with their illustrations.

Use physical buttons or touch, track book or chapter progress in the footer, and choose actions for reading gestures. Straighten scanned pages and recognize text offline with the included English OCR model.

Local dictionaries work offline. You can also select a passage and choose Wikipedia or translation. Reader shows the provider and text before sending an online request.

Preview footnotes on the reading page, search a selected passage and move between dictionary definitions. Open JPEG 2000 images and comic pages.

changes.notes: Saves progress and annotations in Reader’s data folder. Wikipedia and translation send text only after you choose the online action.

versions.notes: Browse printed page labels and display them in the margin or footer. Read with embedded publisher font styles and search up to 5,000 reflowable text matches.
Read GIF illustrations, search with patterns or plain keyboard punctuation, set dictionary order for each book and edit hyphenation for a language.
Read saved notes on the page, choose overlapping highlights, find the previous or next occurrence from your passage and use the offline dictionaries installed with KOReader.

Import nearby EPUB bookmarks and highlights. Preserve publisher paragraph indents, including chapter-opening styles. Find phrases across printed PDF lines. Inspect a PDF link, copy its address or show its QR code.
Import nearby saved positions from KOReader, open DjVu chapter outlines, and extend saved highlights across chapters or fixed pages.

Explore fixed pages in Book map. Find highlights and notes from annotation search, keep matched PDF passages visible at high zoom, and use English word breaks that follow the language of the book or passage.
Open Contents at the current section. Zoomed PDF links bring the specified passage into view. Optional automatic English hyphenation keeps search and bookmarks tied to the original text.

Numbered and nested lists keep their markers. Read supported tables in columns and select text in a cell. Avoid extra blank pages at chapter ends and show more mathematical symbols using installed Kindle fonts.

Open long EPUB chapters with tight line spacing, retain illustrations and resume image-only pages. Read footnotes in place, search a selection and move between dictionary results without losing your passage. Print-color PDFs use less memory. Open JPEG 2000 images and comic pages.

Open more EPUB, AZW3 and MOBI books, including illustrated chapters and extracted EPUB folders. Reader adds customizable gestures, reading progress, scan straightening, offline OCR and optional Wikipedia and translation.
Follows Primitive Launcher's system layer: the theme is the system's, and the power listener survives the redraw signal. A dark library icon. The button that leaves the reader says Exit.
Swipe for icon-based navigation and live reading settings. Reader adds facing pages, independent margins, scan controls, dictionary sources, and an expanded book map and page browser.
Browse folders with file type, size, and support labels. Compact reading bars group navigation and format controls, and text selection and dictionary panels keep the surrounding page visible.

Offline reading with generated EPUB contents, comic panel zoom, navigation, annotations and scanned document tools.
Tested on Kindle Oasis 3 with firmware 5.18.2.
